brand.headline: Everything your school runs on, in one place.
brand.intro: Students, staff, fees and results for admins, teachers, parents and students, each with their own portal.
brand.f1Text: Daily attendance, reports and class schedules.
brand.f2Text: Invoices, collections and defaulters at a glance.
brand.f3Text: Ask questions about your school in plain language.
brand.secure: Secure sign-in. Each school's data is kept separate.

auth.welcome: Welcome back. Choose who you are and enter your login.
auth.remember: Remember my username on this device
auth.hintStaff: Your Employee ID from the job offer letter, or your email.
auth.hintStudent: Students: your Student ID. Parents: the email on the admission letter.
auth.errorEmpty: Please enter your username and password.
auth.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.errorGoogle: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
auth.runningSchoolText: Create your school's own account in a minute. Staff, students and parents get their logins from you (printed on job offer and admission letters).

signup.title: Create your school
signup.intro: Your school gets its own private space. You'll be its administrator and can add staff, students and parents.
signup.currencyHint: Used for fees, salaries and reports. You can change it later in Settings.
signup.languageHint: Default language for your staff, students and parents. Each person can choose their own.
signup.passwordHint: Avoid common words; mix letters, numbers and a symbol.
signup.googleAs: You'll sign in as {{email}}. No password needed.

dashboard.subtitle: {{date}} · here's how your school is doing
dashboard.askText: Try "Fee defaulters this month", "Attendance summary for Grade 8" or "Which students are at risk?"

setup.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} steps done. Your school's data is private to your school.

steps.profile: Add your school profile (logo, address, phone)

locale.title: Language & currency
locale.intro: Choose the currency your school uses and the language everyone sees by default.
locale.currencyNote: Changing the currency changes how amounts are shown. Existing amounts are not converted.
locale.schoolLanguageNote: Staff, students and parents see this language unless they choose their own.
locale.myLanguageNote: Only changes the language for you, on this device.
locale.adminOnly: Only the school administrator can change the school's currency and language.
locale.translationNote: Menus, sign-in, dashboard and settings are translated. Other screens are being translated and show English until then.
locale.confirmCurrency: Change the school currency to {{currency}}? Amounts are not converted.
